what: Spot illustrations for the website (Open Flow 0.2, Daylight; DEC-20261025-A), matched set v2.
made_with: ChatGPT image generation, run through the Codex CLI (codex-cli 0.153.4, image_generation feature) under the founder subscription, on 2026-10-26. One shared brief template (same camera, light, materials and colours), one subject per image, first generation, no retouching. Transparent PNG output, downscaled to 1024px wide (cta-ribbons 1600px) and saved as WebP with alpha (quality 86), so each sits on light and dark surfaces with no plate.
rights: Generated for Strale; no third-party artwork, logos, text or likenesses were requested or appear.

items.brief:
Format: square 1:1. One centred group of objects that fills about 70 percent of the width, with even empty margin on all sides. Camera: the same gentle three-quarter view from slightly above for every image in this set. Light: soft key light from the upper left, faint rim light, one soft contact shadow directly under the group (the only shadow; it must fade to fully transparent).

Subject: a pale bank or ID card tilted at an angle; a single teal ribbon loops once through a slot in the card and ends in a round teal badge holding a white check mark.

Materials and colour (the brand's set, use exactly these): smooth satin-glossy ribbons and accents in electric blue #3027ff, violet #7222ff and teal #008c87, with small pale pink-lilac highlights #eecff2. Neutral objects (paper, cards, screens, buildings) are matte white to very pale grey (#f6f6f9) with softly rounded edges. Stand-in text is short pale grey bars, never letters.

Style: premium product illustration, crisp and clean like Stripe or Linear marketing art. Sharp silhouettes, no blur, no glow halos, no haze, no bokeh, no sparkles, no gradient background. No characters, no faces, no hands, no text, letters, numbers, flags or logos.
